items.title: Indonesia’s most dangerous fires are burning underground
items.title_en: Indonesia’s most dangerous fires are burning underground
items.title_zh: 印度尼西亚最危险的火灾正在地下肆虐
items.summary_en: Indonesia’s dangerous peat fires are surging early in the 2026 fire season as a strengthening El Niño and severe drought dry out wetlands that can burn underground for months. These slow smoldering fires are especially destructive because they release far more fine particles and several pollutants than typical tropical forest fires, while thick smoke can make them difficult for satellites to detect.
items.summary_zh: 随着厄尔尼诺现象加剧和严重干旱导致湿地干涸——这些湿地可能在地下持续燃烧数月——印度尼西亚危险的泥炭地火灾在2026年火灾季初期正呈激增态势。 这些缓慢阴燃的火灾破坏力尤为巨大，因为它们释放的细颗粒物和多种污染物远多于典型的热带森林火灾，而浓烟又使得卫星难以探测到它们。
